prior: Expect bounded exact correctness and unresolved generic solving/cost interfaces; unplanted sparse domains may be empty. No expected speed advantage.
scope: Engineering/math checks after exact snapshots, not official promotion or canonical admission.

blind_from: producer implementation and headline counts until independent derivation
joints.attack: Reconstruct complete strata, domains and pole conditions; inject omitted roots and nonseparable fibre.

blind_from: producer arithmetic/headline ranks until independent reconstruction
joints.attack: Compute labels modulo r, signed incidence nullspace, scaled determinant and orbit quotient rank; inject c=(r,0,...), unbalanced triangle and forged rank.

blind_from: producer map arithmetic/norm values until independent formulas
joints.attack: Reconstruct normalized inverse, extension kernels, degree-two supports and infinity normalization; test omitted conjugate and matching norms of unequal classes.

blindness: Fresh sessions do not read each other. Record any exposure. Producer-code replay is not blind rederivation.
proves_too_much: nonseparable fibre cannot be certified reduced
nonzero integer coefficients may all vanish mod r
short vectors need not vanish at integer roots
matching cover norms do not prove class equality
deviations: Record unavailable primary sources, unprobed models/runtime, custody/independence gaps and every untested joint.
